lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is the Telluride Regional Medical Center board's special meeting Wednesday, where they'll go into executive session and then vote publicly on who's running the hospital in the near term — that's not a routine item. Alongside that, Mountain Village takes up a first reading on shifting affordable housing fees out of municipal code, HARC looks at a potential demolition and new construction at Rebekah Hall, and the county commissioners weigh in on constitutional amendments and a view-plain MOU with Mountain Village. Blues & Brews kicks off Thursday, so the valley's about to get busy.

notable.stake: Board votes publicly on who leads the hospital after executive session.

BOCC weighs constitutional amendments and a Mountain Village view-plain MOU.
